text:
Sundream Studio | Multiple Roles | Full-time / Contract | NYC / Remote

  Sundream Studio is an AI filmmaking app that makes it impossibly easy to create long-form AI video content.

  Try it here for free: https://sundream.studio

  We’re hiring:

  • AI Video Content Creators — make films, ads, and tutorials with Sundream, experiment with new models, and help shape our creative workflows.

  • Software Engineer — build the assistant, generation infrastructure, and editing tools that turn creative decisions into finished videos.

  • Go-to-Market — help filmmakers, creators, and businesses discover Sundream through content, community, partnerships, and growth experiments.

  • Engineering Manager — lead technical execution, grow the engineering team, and stay close to the product and code.

  • Product Designer — make a complex filmmaking workflow feel understandable, fluid, and enjoyable.


  Reach out directly at stefan@sundream.studio with the role you’re interested in, a little about yourself, and something you’ve built, designed, or created that you're proud of. Thanks :)
